```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Nuclear energy is the most reliable zero-carbon emissions source of energy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Unwarranted fear mongering with no relationship to current technologies and safeguards has prevented the start of construction of a single nuclear power plant in 31 years.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The U.S. Navy has for decades relied upon nuclear-powered vessels.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Other nations have harnessed nuclear power to provide a major portion of their energy consumption.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States can catch up and harness nuclear power to provide a major portion of its energy consumption.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans will pursue dramatic increases in the use of all forms of safe, affordable, reliable, and clean nuclear power.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"As new plants are constructed using the highest safety and operation standards, the nation's industrial and manufacturing base will be rejuvenated.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The labor force will expand, with nearly 15,000 high quality jobs created for every new nuclear plant built.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Those workers will lead the nation away from its dependence on foreign oil.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
